title: sutra_provenance — git archaeology per symbol
description:
Walk every commit that touched a symbol's byte range. Classify each commit (creation / bugfix / refactor / feature / perf / rename / revert) from commit-message heuristics. Emit a narrative.

Symbol → file:byte-range is already known. Commit classification is a small rule table (`fix:` prefix → bugfix, `feat:` → feature, etc.). Narrative is template-based.

Worst case heuristics are mediocre — graceful degradation (just show classified-or-unknown commit list).

Tool shape: `sutra_provenance(symbol)` → ordered commit list with classification, author, summary string.

See docs/feature-ideas.md → "sutra_provenance".

**Independent of other simple-additions tasks.**

acceptance_criteria.text: sutra_provenance(symbol) returns commit list ordered chronologically
Classification rules documented; new categories easy to add
Handles symbol-rename history (follow file rename via git log --follow)
